# DevFlow

> DevFlow is an AI-native project management platform: structured 7-stage flows, an AI agent that plans and implements gated by your team's knowledge, and a wiki that compounds with every release.

- [Features](https://devflow-platform-kappa.vercel.app/#features): structured flows, AI agent, kanban board, releases, orgs & teams
- [Pricing](https://devflow-platform-kappa.vercel.app/#pricing): free tier, no credit card required
- [Docs / REST API (Swagger)](https://devflow-api-vd5h.onrender.com/swagger): full REST API reference for personal access tokens and integrations
- [Log in](https://devflow-platform-kappa.vercel.app/login): existing workspace members
- [Get started free](https://devflow-platform-kappa.vercel.app/register): create a workspace in minutes
